speaker: 弥紀
jp:
ここは進路指導室。
進学や就職のための資料が
揃ってて自由に閲覧出来るよ。
en:
This is the career guidance office. It's stocked with
materials on colleges and jobs, and you can look
through them freely.

speaker: 弥紀
jp:
今年は担任の羽鳥先生が
担当だから、気兼ねなく
色々質問出来るんだ。
en:
This year our homeroom teacher, Hatori-sensei, is in
charge, so you can ask all kinds of questions
without feeling awkward.
